test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Abhishek marks the price of his laptop 50 percent above the cost price. He allows his customer a discount of 30 percent on the marked price. What is the profit percentage ?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹100

Marked Price (MP) = ₹150

Discount = 30%

Selling Price (SP) = MP - Discount

**Formula used:**

Profit Percentage = dfrac{SP - CP}{CP} times 100&
